title: Loomer feuds with Greene over ‘demeaning’ rhetoric about Angie Nixon
text:
Former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene clashed with right-wing influencer Laura Loomer over her inflammatory remarks about Democratic Senate candidate Angie Nixon.

Over the weekend, Loomer and Nixon got into an increasingly heated verbal confrontation, with the influencer repeatedly calling the candidate a “Ghetto black communist b****,” among other obscenities. Greene, who used to occupy a similar role to Loomer’s in the MAGAsphere as a right-wing provocateur but has since tried to moderate her image, called Loomer out on X and blamed President Donald Trump for her rhetoric.
